title: Trends Involving Singaporeans Seeking Primary Healthcare Services at Polyclinics and Family Clinics
what_it_is: Trends Involving Singaporeans Seeking Primary Healthcare Services at Polyclinics and Family Clinics

sections.label: GP and polyclinic visit data
sections.summary: Non-CHAS GP visits are not in MOH records; of recorded patients, 82% visited polyclinics and 36% GP clinics, with referrals making up 32% and 7% of new SOC attendances.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Non-CHAS visits to GPs are not included as the Ministry of Health (MOH) does not routinely collect such data from GPs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Of the patients included in our records, 82% visited polyclinics and 36% visited GP clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Referrals from polyclinics and GPs make up 32% and 7% respectively of new attendances at our Specialist Outpatient Clinics (SOCs).

sections.label: Cardiology patients managed in primary care
sections.summary: Preliminary cardiology findings showed about 57% of heart patients previously referred to specialists can be safely managed mainly in primary care.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: On cardiology, for example, preliminary findings showed that about 57% of heart patients who previously would have been referred to specialists can be safely managed mainly in the primary care setting.

sections.label: More polyclinics and CHAS GP use
sections.summary: More polyclinics will be built in coming years while patients who qualify for CHAS are encouraged to use services provided by CHAS GPs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In the coming few years, we will be building more polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But at the same time, we are also encouraging patients who qualify for CHAS to utilise some of the services that are provided by the CHAS GP.

sections.label: Family Medicine Clinics and primary care networks
sections.summary: Family Medicine Clinics show positive results but scalability is a challenge; MOH is trying a primary care network where GPs share processes, resources and ancillary support virtually.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The Family Medicine Clinics have shown some positive results but, at the same time, we do understand that the scalability can be a challenge because of the fact that we need to mobilise the GPs, who are mainly in the solo practices, to come together to form a Family Medicine Centre.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, MOH is trying out other initiatives and one of these initiatives that MOH will be embarking on is that of a primary care network, where a network of GPs can come together to provide team-based care on a virtual basis, where they will still practise at their own clinic premises but, at the same time, share processes, resources as well as other ancillary support.
